Part of the emoji keywords (assets/emoji_index.txt) comes from the emoji annotations of the
Unicode Common Locale Data Repository (https://github.com/unicode-org/cldr), English and Romanian:
common/annotations and common/annotationsDerived.

The list of emoji (assets/emoji.txt) comes from the Unicode emoji data file
emoji-test.txt (https://unicode.org/Public/emoji/latest/emoji-test.txt).
